name: MPulse Summer Performing Arts Institutes
org: University of Michigan School of Music, Theatre and Dance
what_you_do: Live on campus for 1 to 4 weeks and study music, theatre or dance with U-M faculty. There are 16 institutes, from jazz and strings to musical theatre, dance and theatre design. Each ends with a performance.
who_can_apply: High school students who want to study their art in college. Each institute has its own audition rules. For example, the Jazz Institute is for students entering grades 9 to 12.
pay_detail: Cost covers tuition, a dorm room and meals, and differs by institute. In 2026 the Jazz Institute was $1,950. The application fee is $75 (fee waivers exist). Merit and need based scholarships are offered.
duration: 1 to 4 weeks, June 20 to July 31, 2027, by institute (for example Jazz July 4 to 10, Musical Theatre Workshop July 11 to 31).
deadline_text: MPulse 2027 applications are open now. The priority deadline is February 1, 2027. After that, institutes take applications until they are full.
how_to_apply: Pick an institute on the MPulse page. Apply online through Acceptd and send an audition video or a portfolio. Apply by the priority deadline to be in the running for scholarships.
notes: Need based aid is for families with income of $125,000 or less. Michigan residents with family income of $75,000 or less can apply for the Watson A. Young scholarship. Students under 18 live in Bursley Hall and may not leave campus alone. 2027 dates for Girls in Music and Technology and the Harp Institute are not set. Questions: mpulse@umich.edu.
